svg.title: Gross pay vs take-home pay per month: two synthetic co-op offers (estimates)
svg.desc: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, all figures are estimates, not payroll advice. Grouped horizontal bars compare monthly gross pay with monthly take-home (after estimated tax, CPP, EI, rent, commuting and moving, plus an after-tax signing bonus) for two made-up 16-week co-op offers. Toronto data analyst (synthetic): $4,549.65 gross, $677.93 take-home per month. Waterloo QA developer (synthetic): $4,159.68 gross, $1,640.89 take-home per month. The offer with the higher hourly rate keeps less each month.
